title: banana textures
description: Allows you to change elytra and (cross)bow's textures via commands!
body:
Adds 2 commands which change the "Custom Model Data" NBT:
```
/elytra_style
```
Allows you to chose between 7 types of elytra's


```
/bow_style
```
Allows you to chose between 2 types of bow's

The textures are built into the mod. To make the elytra (when wearing) to work, you have to install [Cit resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)

# Used textures:
## Elytras
- [Fairy wings](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/fairy-wings-elytra/files/6445218)
- [Pixie wings](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/sugrcube-s-shimmering-pixie-wings-elytra/)
- [Cloud elytra](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/cloudy-elytra-wings/)
- [Owl wings](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/snow-owl-wings-elytra/)
- [Moth wings](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/4-o-clock-moth-elytra-wings-32x-soft-version/)
- [dragonfly](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/orange-and-pink-dragonfly-elytra-wings/)
- [dragon wings](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/elytra-dragon-style), colors modified to look like light fury
## Bows
- [Flower and Wisteria](https://www.planetminecraft.com/texture-pack/flower-bow/), imported to Java
